series_metadata.tagline: Smart NFC Keepsake Greeting Cards That Come Alive with a Single Tap

cards.title: Winter Gala & Holiday Sparkle
cards.theme: Frosted Sapphire, Crystal Snow & Silver Elegance
cards.headline: Warmest Holiday Wishes

narrative.card_back_lore: As evening descends upon the snow-dusted estate, Seraphina lights the crystalline ice lanterns, extending an exclusive holiday invitation to an evening of champagne, joyful laughter, and timeless winter wonder.
narrative.quote: May your holidays sparkle with moments of pure joy, peace, and warmth among the ones you cherish.

cards.title: Black Friday VIP Spree
cards.theme: Gold Foil, Noir Glamour & Holiday Shopping
cards.headline: VIP Shopping Pass & Holiday Treats

narrative.card_back_lore: With shopping bags in hand and a stylish faux-fur collar against the chill, Briar unlocks the ultimate holiday deals pass. Tap to reveal exclusive doorbusters, discount codes, or surprise holiday gift balances.
narrative.quote: Treat yourself to everything you love this holiday season—you've earned every single moment.

cards.title: Cozy Fireside & Christmas Hearth
cards.theme: Crackling Fireplace, Warm Cocoa & Pine Glow
cards.headline: Merry Christmas & Peaceful Nights

narrative.card_back_lore: Snow falls gently beyond the frost-framed window while pine logs crackle on the hearth. A steaming mug of cocoa sits beside handwritten letters, filling the home with cinnamon and holiday serenity.
narrative.quote: Wishing you the coziest Christmas filled with deep peace, warm fires, and the comfort of home.

cards.title: Midnight Champagne & Fireworks
cards.theme: Starlight Gold, Confetti Rain & Rooftop City Lights
cards.headline: Happy New Year!

narrative.card_back_lore: As the clock strikes midnight, crystal glasses clink beneath an illuminated skyline of burst gold and emerald fireworks. Here's to leaving behind old doubts and welcoming 365 fresh chapters of boundless triumph.
narrative.quote: Cheers to new adventures, bold dreams, and the happiest, most prosperous year yet!

cards.title: Neon Birthday Glow Bash
cards.theme: Vibrant Magenta, Neon Confetti & Birthday Anthem
cards.headline: Happy Birthday!

narrative.card_back_lore: Lighting up the night with pulsating neon glow and multi-colored holographic balloons! Tap to start your personalized video birthday greeting featuring unforgettable memories and celebratory beats.
narrative.quote: Wishing you another incredible trip around the sun packed with laughter, love, and wild success!

cards.title: Golden Milestone Anniversary
cards.theme: Embossed Gold Foil, Satin Ivory & Champagne
cards.headline: Forever & Always

narrative.card_back_lore: Two souls whose journey grows richer with every passing year. A tribute to shared laughter, weathered storms, and the steadfast love that turns ordinary days into golden masterpieces.
narrative.quote: Through every season, your love remains our greatest inspiration. Happy Anniversary!

cards.title: Heartfelt Botanical Gratitude
cards.theme: Eucalyptus Green, Rose Gold Foil & Watercolor Blooms
cards.headline: With Sincerest Thanks

narrative.card_back_lore: Some gestures make an indelible mark on our hearts. This card expresses profound gratitude for your selfless generosity, gentle guidance, and unwavering presence when it mattered most.
narrative.quote: Words cannot fully capture how much your kindness has meant. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

cards.title: Unstoppable Champion & Victory
cards.theme: Electric Cobalt, Golden Laurels & Victory Anthem
cards.headline: You Conquered the Summit!

narrative.card_back_lore: Late nights, tireless discipline, and unyielding ambition have brought you to this crowning victory. Stand tall on the podium of your achievements—the future is wide open for your next great triumph.
narrative.quote: Huge congratulations on your phenomenal victory! The world is taking notice of what you can do.

cards.title: Thinking of You & Warm Hugs
cards.alias: A Pocket Hug Across the Miles
cards.theme: Lavender Sunset, Soft Cloud Mist & Warm Chai
cards.headline: Sending You So Much Love

narrative.card_back_lore: Miles may stretch between us, but you are never far from my thoughts. Keep this card in your wallet or on your nightstand as a physical reminder that someone is always cheering for you and sending you warm love.
narrative.quote: Just a little reminder that you are loved, you are appreciated, and you are never alone.

cards.title: Sweet Baby Arrival & Starlight
cards.theme: Moonlight Pearl, Pastel Mint & Starlight Glow
cards.headline: Welcome to the World, Little Miracle!

narrative.card_back_lore: Ten little fingers, ten little toes, and a love that knows no bounds. Welcome to the precious new bundle of joy whose arrival fills the entire universe with starlight and wonder.
narrative.quote: Congratulations to the proud parents! Wishing your family a lifetime of laughter and sweet cuddles.

cards.title: Forever Vows & Wedding Elegance
cards.theme: Champagne Silk, White Peonies & Gilded Calligraphy
cards.headline: Congratulations on Your Wedding Day

narrative.card_back_lore: Hand in hand, heart to heart, beginning a journey of shared dreams and everlasting devotion. May your marriage be filled with endless grace, gentle understanding, and abiding joy.
narrative.quote: Here's to love, laughter, and your happily ever after. Congratulations on tying the knot!

cards.title: Custom NFC Video TapGreeting Card
cards.theme: Your Photos, Artwork, Video & Personal Links
cards.headline: Design Your Custom Keepsake Card

specs.video_format: Upload Any Video, Greeting or Link

narrative.card_back_lore: Upload your own photos or custom artwork for the front and back. Encode any personal video message, photo album, voice note, or link directly into the rewritable NFC chip. Crafted in waterproof credit card-grade PVC.
narrative.quote: Turn your cherished video memories and greeting into an unforgettable physical keepsake.
